INTERIM, REDUCED: unchanged ot_hbm_accel_tu_endpoint with FIFO depths RXAW = QAW = TXAW = 4 (16 entries); at the RTL defaults (RXAW 8, QAW 6, TXAW 6) its flop FIFOs hold ~2.5 Mb, more std-cell area than the 1.96 mm2 slot: the endpoint needs SRAM FIFOs before a full-depth view exists. pclk = clk (the PHY clock is the link clock region outside this block). contracts.ep.inj_q: SU-quarter ownership (hgi-takeover 2026-10-09, defined by the die-integration owner): inject flit i (inj_idx, broadcast to all four quarters on t_su_q[546:580]) is owned by quarter i mod 4 in the order SW, NW, SE, NE; the owner drives its 1024-bit f_su_q (hfd_su t_coll), the other three drive 0, so the OR (inside ot_hgi_coll_ep) is the owner data; two or more non-zero quarters in a cycle set the sticky multi-driver fault (review-1149, zero cycles on the data path). The functional SU inject gate is one AND per quarter (the physical envelope hfd_su has no inject select);
